studentJoin.title: Join ClassBridge Room
studentJoin.instructions: Enter your participant code and English nickname. Your partner class is automatically identified from your code.
studentJoin.warning: Warning: Do not enter your real name or school name. Never share your private code with others.

studentActivity.title: Choose Your Favorite Keyring Design
studentActivity.desc: Vote for the commemorative keyring design created by both classes and express your reasons in English!
studentActivity.step2: 2. Click a sentence frame to write your reason
studentActivity.reasonPlaceholder: Select a sentence frame and complete the blank...
studentActivity.submittedDesc: Explore the voting results and public comments from partner students.

activity.cannotDeleteNotice: Activities with student records cannot be deleted. Archive the activity to preserve assessment evidence.
activity.deleteWarning: This action cannot be undone. Only draft activities with 0 submissions, comments, and votes can be deleted. Type the exact activity title below to confirm.
activity.futurePhotoNotice: Student photo attachments will be available later with teacher approval for privacy protection.

activity.archivedListDesc: These activities are hidden from default views and can be restored at any time. Only empty drafts can be permanently deleted.
